title: Why Do Koalas Have Fingerprints? \U0001f428 #Shorts
description:
Koalas have fingerprints almost identical to human fingerprints — even under a microscope, forensic experts struggle to tell them apart. They are the only non-primates on Earth with true fingerprints, evolved independently 70 million years after our lineages split: a gripping adaptation for climbing and picking the perfect eucalyptus leaves.
New animal mysteries on OTIS every day.
